variables.label: Study Identifier
variables.guidance: DI.STUDYID

variables.label: Sponsor Device Identifier
variables.guidance: DI.SPDEVID

variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.guidance: DR.USUBJID. USUBJID is required when USUBJID is linked to one or more devices (SPDEVID) in SDTM DR dataset.

variables.label: Pooled Device Group y
variables.guidance: Character description of a grouping or pooling of devices for analysis purposes. If the algorithm of device grouping is based on DI.DEVTYP or DI.MODEL, DEVTYGy or MODELGy should be used.

variables.label: Pooled Device Group y (N)
variables.guidance: Numeric representation of grouping y of the pooled device group. There must be a one-to-one relationship between DEVGRyN and DEVGRy within a study. DEVGRyN cannot be present unless DEVGRy is also present. When both present, on a given record either both must be populated or both must be null.

variables.label: Pooled Device Type Group y
variables.guidance: Character description of a grouping or pooling of devices for analysis purposes by device type. The value of DI.DIVAL where DI.DIPARMCD='DEVTYPE' is always used to create the device type grouping variable.

variables.label: Pooled Device Type Group y (N)
variables.guidance: Numeric representation of grouping y of the pooled device type group. There must be a one-to-one relationship between DEVTYGyN and DEVTYGy within a study. DEVTYGyN cannot be present unless DEVTYGy is also present. When both present, on a given record either both must be populated or both must be null.

variables.label: Pooled Device Model Group y
variables.guidance: Character description of a grouping or pooling of devices for analysis purposes by device model. The value of DI.DIVAL where DI.DIPARMCD='MODEL' is always used to create the device model grouping variable.

variables.label: Pooled Device Model Group y (N)
variables.guidance: Numeric representation of grouping y of the pooled device type group. There must be a one-to-one relationship between MODELGyN and MODELGy within a study. MODELGyN cannot be present unless MODELGy is also present. When both present, on a given record either both must be populated or both must be null.

variables.label: Date of First Exposure to Device
variables.guidance: Date of first exposure to the device for the subject. 'First exposure' to device is defined in the SAP. Similar to the TRTSDT variable from ADSL, DEVSDT is used for analysis when merged onto other device analysis datasets.

variables.label: Date of Last Exposure to Device
variables.guidance: Date of last exposure to the device for the subject. 'Last exposure' to device is defined in the SAP. Similar to the TRTEDT variable from ADSL, DEVEDT is used for analysis when merged onto other device analysis datasets.

variables.label: Device Active Flag
variables.guidance: DEVAFL indicates whether device is active at a time point specified in the SAP. Values must be Y or N (or Y and missing). It is permissible to use DEVAyFL if multiple flags are needed, with labels 'Device Active y Flag'. A simple derivation might be to set this flag to Y when DEVEDT is missing.

variables.label: Date Device Implanted
variables.guidance: Date device implanted in the subject. DEVIPDT is required when device is implanted.

variables.label: Date Device Explanted
variables.guidance: Date device explanted from the subject. DEVXPDT is required when device is explanted or DEVIPDT is present.

variables.label: Date Device Turned On
variables.guidance: Date device is turned on. DEVONDT is required when the device is able to be turned on. For multiple occurrences, either collapse into 1 record in ADDL (algorithm defined in SAP) or use DEVONyDT.

variables.label: Date Device Turned Off
variables.guidance: Date device is turned off. DEVOFDT is required when the device is able to be turned off, or DEVONDT is present. For multiple occurrences, either collapse into 1 record in ADDL (algorithm defined in SAP) or use DEVOFyDT.

variables.label: Date Device Repositioned
variables.guidance: DEVRPDT indicates date when device was repositioned. DEVRPDT is required when a device could be repositioned and included in analysis. For multiple occurrences, either collapse into 1 record in ADDL (algorithm defined in SAP) or use DEVRPyDT.

variables.label: Date Device Modified
variables.guidance: DEVMDDT indicates date when device was modified for a subject in a study. What qualifies as device modification is defined by study protocol and SAP. DEVMDDT is required when the device could be modified and included in analysis. For multiple occurrences, either collapse into 1 record in ADDL (algorithm defined in SAP) or use DEVMDyDT.

variables.label: Subject Age at First Exposure to Device
variables.guidance: Age of the subject at DEVSDT. Used only if age at device exposure start date is needed for analysis. Otherwise, use ADSL.AGE.

variables.label: Age at First Exposure to Device Unit
variables.guidance: Age unit usually is same as the ADSL.AGEU. If it is different, then AGEDSTU is required. Codelist: AGEU.

variables.label: Sponsor Device Identifier
variables.guidance: ADDL.SPDEVID.

variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.guidance: ADDL.USUBJID. USUBJID is required when subject-device relationship is defined in ADDL.

variables.label: Sponsor Device Identifier
variables.guidance: ADDL.SPDEVID.

variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.guidance: ADDL.USUBJID. USUBJID is required when subject-device relationship is defined in ADDL.

variables.label: Analysis Sequence Number
variables.guidance: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of records within an ADaM dataset. ASEQ uniquely indexes records within a subject, or within a device, or within a subject and device; within an ADaM dataset. Useful for traceability when the dataset is used as input to another ADaM dataset.

conformance_rules.description: ADDL must contain 1 record per device per subject combination.
In a study, there is only 1 dataset in the class 'DEVICE LEVEL ANALYSIS DATASET', and its name is ADDL.
USUBJID is conditionally required: required when USUBJID is linked to one or more devices (SPDEVID) in SDTM DR dataset.

DEVGRyN cannot be present unless DEVGRy is also present. There must be a one-to-one relationship between DEVGRyN and DEVGRy within a study. When both are present, on a given record either both must be populated or both must be null.

DEVTYGyN cannot be present unless DEVTYGy is also present. There must be a one-to-one relationship between DEVTYGyN and DEVTYGy within a study. When both are present, on a given record either both must be populated or both must be null.

MODELGyN cannot be present unless MODELGy is also present. There must be a one-to-one relationship between MODELGyN and MODELGy within a study. When both are present, on a given record either both must be populated or both must be null.

DEVAFL (and DEVAyFL) character flag variables whose names end in FL can have at most two possible non-missing values: Y or N. If it satisfies the analysis need, Y and missing can be used instead of Y and N.
DEVIPDT is required when device is implanted.
DEVXPDT is required when device is explanted or DEVIPDT is present.
DEVONDT is required when the device is able to be turned on.
DEVOFDT is required when the device is able to be turned off, or DEVONDT is present.
DEVRPDT is required when a device could be repositioned and included in analysis.
DEVMDDT is required when the device could be modified and included in analysis.
AGEDSTU is required when age unit differs from ADSL.AGEU.
ADSL is required for medical device studies only when subject information is collected and needs to be reported. If ADSL is not included, an explanation should be included in the ADRG.
SPDEVID is a required identifier variable. USUBJID is conditionally required when subject-device relationship is defined in ADDL.
DETERM and DEDECOD are required variables in MDOCCDS. This differs from OCCDS(ADVERSE EVENT) where AETERM, AEDECOD, and AEBODSYS are required.

The following OCCDS qualifiers would not generally be used in DE/MDOCCDS: --BODSYS, --SER, --ACN, --REL, --RELNST, --PATT, --OUT, --SCAN, --SCONG, --SDISAB, --SDTH, --SHOSP, --SLIFE, --SOD, --SMIE, --CONTRT, --TOX, --TOXGR.
The SDTM input dataset for MDOCCDS is always Device Events (DE), with additional information from related datasets such as SUPPDE and Findings About Events or Interventions (FA).

SPDEVID is a required key variable. USUBJID is conditionally required when subject-device relationship is defined in ADDL. Structure is 1 or more records per subject (optional), per device, per analysis parameter, and per timepoint (optional).
ASEQ uniquely indexes records within a subject, or within a device, or within a subject and device; within an ADaM dataset.
When the relationship between subjects and devices is not collected, ADDL must be included.
If multiple records per device are needed in a device exposure analysis dataset, this information does not belong in ADDL. Instead, it should be put into a BDS structure.

dataset_structures.name: ADDL
dataset_structures.structure: One record per device per subject (or one record per device when subject data not collected)

dataset_structures.name: MDOCCDS
dataset_structures.structure: Usually 1 record per each record in the corresponding SDTM domain (optional: per coding path, per Analysis Period and/or Phase)

dataset_structures.name: MDBDS
dataset_structures.structure: One record per subject (optional), per device, per parameter (optional: per timepoint)

dataset_structures.name: MDTTE
dataset_structures.structure: One record per subject (optional), per device, per parameter, per timepoint (optional)
